data.title: Muster Bank AG: Request to Update Customer Data
data.summary: Muster Bank AG asks David Muster to send a copy of a valid ID and a completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen) to update his customer data under the Anti-Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). The documents must be submitted within 8 business days of the letter's date (18.12.2025), otherwise the bank will block the securities account (Depot) for purchases.
data.explanation: German banks must periodically re-verify customer identity data under anti-money-laundering law. You need to send a copy of your valid ID and the filled-in self-disclosure form to the bank by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the bank says it will block your securities account (Depot) for new purchases until the matter is clarified — this does not affect a legal authority deadline, just the bank's internal process, but it is best to act promptly to keep your account fully usable.
